ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark gray/black) pixels with high-intensity (white) localized clusters; distribution ratio approximately 80:20 dark to light on visible surfaces.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Right lobe: Dense concentration of circular and annular white blobs in the central and lower visible region. Left lobe: High-intensity irregular patch at the distal tip and a distinct cluster of intersecting linear white marks in the center-left.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with distinct peaks and valleys; amplitudes are most pronounced on the trailing edge of the left lobe and upper portion of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex geometric curve fitted to both lobes, rising from the water line toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly visible clusters of circular and ring-shaped high-contrast pixel formations (white on dark) distributed across both lobes, with higher density on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct intersecting linear pixel disruptions forming an 'X' pattern on the central region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive annular scarring (likely cookiecutter shark or barnacle scars) and a prominent 'X'-shaped linear scar on the left lobe; distal tips show irregular, heavily textured edges.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant textural irregularity and high-contrast white accumulation at the distal tips of both lobes.
